kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يحس (form I)
# يَحُسُّ (yaḥussu) /ja.ħus.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”)
# يُحَسُّ (yuḥassu) /ju.ħas.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”) and حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
# يَحُسَّ (yaḥussa) /ja.ħus.sa/: third-person masculine sing
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
